summary.en: UK guitar bands fight for chart position with sixties lineage and class lyrics.
summary.zh: 英国吉他乐队用六十年代谱系与阶级歌词争榜。

sound.en: Big Noel-style choruses, jangly indie, Madchester residue, northern accent vocals
sound.zh: Noel 式大副歌、叮当 Indie、Madchester 余韵、北方口音人声

body.en: Britpop is not UK grunge. It argues for Beatles/Kinks lineage, class storytelling, and NME/chart competition as a national sport. Kept separate so Oasis and Nirvana are not filed under one label.
body.zh: Britpop 不是英国版 Grunge。它主张 Beatles/Kinks 谱系、阶级叙事，以及把 NME/榜单竞争当国民运动。与 Grunge 分开，免得 Oasis 和 Nirvana 被归成同一标签。
